from sortedcontainers import SortedList
import sys

# Initialize the to-do list and undo stack
todo_list = SortedList()
undo_stack = []

# Read the number of operations
q = int(input().strip())

# Process each operation
for _ in range(q):
    operation = input().strip().split()
    
    if operation[0] == 'set':
        ai, xi = operation[1], int(operation[2])
        if ai in undo_stack[-1]:
            undo_stack[-1].remove(ai)
        todo_list.add((xi, ai))
        if ai not in undo_stack:
            undo_stack.append(set())
        undo_stack[-1].add(ai)
    elif operation[0] == 'remove':
        ai = operation[1]
        if ai in undo_stack[-1]:
            undo_stack[-1].remove(ai)
        todo_list.remove((todo_list.get((0, ai))[0], ai))
    elif operation[0] == 'query':
        ai = operation[1]
        if ai not in undo_stack[-1]:
            print(-1)
        else:
            xi = todo_list.get((0, ai))[0]
            print(todo_list.bisect_left((xi, ai)) - 1)
    elif operation[0] == 'undo':
        di = int(operation[1])
        undo_stack.pop()
        for ai in undo_stack[-1]:
            todo_list.remove((todo_list.get((0, ai))[0], ai))

# Flush the output stream
sys.stdout.flush()
